summary: Inside the power plant, the waste port's yawning black snaps shut as the camera pulls back. Red amniotic gel flows into the pod below, pooling around a tiny newborn that suckles its feed tube. Morpheus reflects that for a long time he wouldn't believe the truth, but seeing the fields with his own eyes and watching them liquefy the dead to feed the living intravenously, he came to realize the obviousness of the truth. As the camera keeps pulling back, the power-plant image is revealed to be playing on a television, and the scene returns to the white space of the construct.

what_changes.before: unwilling to believe the truth about the machines
what_changes.after: having realized the obviousness of the truth after seeing the fields
what_changes.evidence: For the longest time, I wouldn't believe it.  But then I saw the fields with my own eyes

what_changes.before: confronting the horror of the fields directly
what_changes.after: recognizing the horrifying precision as the obvious truth
what_changes.evidence: facing the efficiency, the pure, horrifying precision, I came to realize the obviousness of the truth.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus recounts how witnessing the fetus fields forced him to accept the truth about the machines.
